title: levelandplates
description: A Minecraft mod that adds levels and unique name plates to mobs, making encounters more dynamic and immersive.
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6555a30c4598370603a3238189c5554e97fb8a7.jpeg)

# Level and Plates: A World Evolving
Level and Plates transforms how you perceive the dangers of Minecraft. No longer is every encounter the same; the world now breathes with a dynamic progression system where every creature carries its own strength, its own history, and a visual identity that fits perfectly into the horizon.

# The Soul of the World
Natural Evolution: As you venture further from the heart of your world, the denizens of the dark grow in power. Mobs found in distant lands or harsher dimensions carry greater health, fortified armor, and devastating strength.

## Seamless Visuals: 
Experience a new way to track your foes. Whether you prefer a classic RPG interface, minimalist indicators, or traditional heart displays, the world’s information is woven directly into your field of vision.

![minecraft level mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d5f2632b32a6b18cb95c3dfc1dd1e973198de19.jpeg)

# Environmental Awareness:

True to the laws of the world, a creature’s presence is only revealed when it is truly seen. If a monster lurks behind a wall or deep within a cavern, its identity remains a mystery until you come face-to-face.

# Master Your Interface
/lp changestyle [style] – Seamlessly switch between six distinct visual identities: NORMAL, MINIMAL, RPG, BAR_SIMPLE, BAR_ROBUST, and HEARTS.

/lp toggle – Instantly clear your vision for a pure, cinematic experience.

# Lightweight & Integrated

Built with a "Vanilla+" philosophy, Level and Plates is designed to be invisible to your performance while remaining vital to your gameplay. With a smart 24-block visibility limit and native-aligned logic, it feels like a core part of the game rather than an overlay.

# The Journey Continues
The world is still growing. While the creatures of the wild evolve today, future updates will bring Player Progression, allowing you to grow in power alongside the ever-strengthening threats of the world.
